param_input_item.param_description: 3-D logical volume, 3-D nonnegative integer label volume, or connected-component structure from bwconncomp.
Optional intensity volume with the same size as regions.
Property names, 'basic', 'all', or a cell array of property names.

param_output_item.param_description: Structure array containing one element per region.

description.p: regionprops3 measures connected regions in 3-D volumes. Supported geometric properties include Volume, Centroid, BoundingBox, VoxelIdxList, VoxelList, Image, SubarrayIdx, Extent, and EquivDiameter.
When an intensity volume is provided, supported intensity properties include MeanIntensity, MinIntensity, MaxIntensity, VoxelValues, and WeightedCentroid.

example_item.example_item_description: Measure objects in a synthetic volume and display one labeled slice.
